highlight.ja: /model や /effort を送ったときに、モデルや effort が勝手に選ばれたり、既定が書き換わったりする問題を直しました。
highlight.en: Fixed sending /model or /effort picking a model or effort on its own, or overwriting your default.

fixed.en: Fixed the /model and /effort pickers in Claude Code 2.1.329 and later not being operable from the buttons.

fixed.en: Fixed answering /model in Claude Code 2.1.329 and later overwriting the default model. Auto-Yes no longer answers this screen.

fixed.en: Fixed /effort sent to Claude Code 2.1.329 and later being reported as possibly not delivered.
